feature_name: Client IP Extraction for Axum Framework
description: Implement a client IP extractor for the Axum web framework that can reliably determine the originating IP address of incoming HTTP requests. This extractor should handle common proxy scenarios and integrate seamlessly with the existing Axum routing infrastructure.
functional_requirements: Create a new extractor module that can parse X-Forwarded-For headers and other common proxy headers to determine the true client IP
Integrate the client IP extractor with the existing Axum router and middleware system for easy use in route handlers
Ensure the extractor properly handles edge cases like missing headers, malformed values, and direct connections without proxies
Add appropriate tracing and logging to help debug IP extraction issues during development and production use
